purpose: Situation -> capability -> authority -> fallback. When a listed situation occurs, use the mapped capability before improvising. Hand-rolling a check that an existing diagnostic already performs is how capability decays into shelfware.

authority_levels.authoritative: Its verdict decides the question. Overriding it requires a governance artifact.
authority_levels.blocking: It can stop a merge or a transition on its own.
authority_levels.advisory: Its objection is a signal worth acting on; its approval is not a gate. CI, Merge Gate and PM policy remain the blocking authority.

field_contract.situation: The trigger, phrased as the condition an agent actually observes.
field_contract.capability: The command, skill or agent to reach for first. Every value must exist -- a command in package.json, an agent in .claude/agents/, a skill in .claude/commands/.
field_contract.fallback: What to reach for when the primary capability does not resolve the situation, or null when escalation is the only remaining step.
field_contract.notes: Optional. Why this mapping exists, usually a defect it prevents.

situations.situation: Deciding whether there is room to start new work
situations.notes: Canonical active-lane union and dispatch slots. Never infer capacity from lane manifests alone, and never from memory.

situations.situation: Before any dispatch cycle
situations.notes: Expected, not optional. Validates concurrency headroom and forbidden combinations before work is added to the board.

situations.situation: A file or path may already be claimed by another lane
situations.notes: Leases are a separate population from manifests. A manifest-only check returns false all-clears; lane-start then refuses on lease_conflict. The report surfaces leases by heartbeat staleness, so a lease that leaked seconds ago is invisible to it -- read the lease file directly when a lane has just closed.

situations.situation: Lane substrate looks missing or inconsistent
situations.notes: Transient WSL2 ENOENT is not deletion. Re-probe before tearing anything down.

situations.situation: Choosing what to work on next
situations.notes: Candidate generation only. Confirm against ops:execution-state before dispatching.

situations.situation: CI is red and the cause is not obvious from the checks list
situations.notes: Expected, not optional. Reads workflow logs and returns the failing step, root cause and a specific remediation. A check with an empty output summary always requires the run log.

situations.situation: Broad repository or workflow health check
A workflow is misconfigured or not dispatching
A PR will not merge and the reason is unclear
situations.notes: mergeStateStatus reflects the whole check rollup, not just the required subset, so a non-required red check makes every PR read BLOCKED. A required context that was never created reads as absent rather than failing.

situations.situation: Before claiming a PR is ready to merge
situations.notes: Run it; do not assert readiness from a green checks list.

situations.situation: Deciding whether a lane is Done
situations.notes: The done-gate. Never self-certify Done. There is no fallback: if it fails, fix the lane.

situations.situation: Diagnosing a lane's closeability without mutating it
situations.notes: Writes nothing and certifies nothing. A dry run cannot close a lane: it records no truth_check_history entry. Distinguish it mechanically by dry_run/certifies in --json output.

situations.situation: Starting or closing a lane
situations.notes: The only sanctioned lifecycle transitions. There is no fallback -- a lane transitioned by any other means is not governed.

situations.situation: Lane manifests, Linear and GitHub have drifted apart
Assessing risk on a PR before merge
Reviewing work returned by Codex
situations.notes: Required by the separation-of-review rule before merging Codex-produced changes.

situations.situation: Auditing a proof bundle or R-level evidence
Verifying runtime truth and CI evidence on the merge SHA
situations.notes: Never rely on branch CI alone.

situations.situation: Reviewing live-DB proof for a T1 evidence bundle
Checking what automation exists and what is unwired
situations.notes: Run this before building any new script, agent or workflow.

situations.situation: Current system state at the start of a session
Finding executable candidates for the day
